No. 40 of 1927.
British Residency & Consulate General,
Bushire, the 6th January 1927.

Two copies of the undermentioned paper are forwarded to
the Political Agent, Muscat,
the Political Agent, Bahrein,
the Political Agent, Kuwait,
His Majesty's Consul, Bandar Abbas,
British Vice-Consul, Mohammerah,
British Consular Agent, Lingeh,
for favour of giving wide publicity to the Proclamation.

By order,
Captain,
Secretary to the Political Resident
in the Persian Gulf.
